summary: Agents can import large DXF, UPID and machine-package files through browser-local attachment tokens without embedding file contents in tool calls.
warning: Attachment tokens expire on replacement, reload or a changed workbench. Attaching a file does not import or install it. Existing projects, packages and revisions are preserved; no post or controller output changes.

checklist.schema: Adds source:{fileToken} as an alternative to existing inline tool input. No project, UPID, saved revision, machine-package or post schema changes.
checklist.events: No execution-event changes. New edm_request_import_file opens a native attachment dialog. DXF unit review and package preview/installation remain separate operations.
checklist.capabilities: No machine or post capabilities change. Local immutable File tokens use ordinary import limits: DXF 16 MiB, UPID 64 MiB and packages 32 MiB. Inline limits remain supported.
checklist.auditAndOutput: No export, compiler or audit changes. Attachment tokens do not permit arbitrary paths, remote URLs or another tab's files.
checklist.installationAndStorage: Shared import/installation operations retain draft/version/cancellation checks and browser/folder transactions. No automatic changes to installed posts, original files or saved revisions.
checklist.verification: 117 WebMCP tests pass, including oversized input, replacement, cancellation, stale tokens, unit preview and package preparation without installation. Chromium imports a 4,363-segment multi-megabyte UPID and a DXF exceeding the agent script budget through token-only calls, verifies geometry, then reloads. Native TypeScript, lint and shared UI checks pass. Software checks do not establish physical machine verification.

publicNotes.summary: Attach large files for agent imports without pasting their contents.
changes: Open an attachment dialog with edm_request_import_file or the Agent activity panel.
Pass the returned file token to normal DXF, UPID or machine-package preparation and import tools.
publicNotes.compatibility: Existing inline calls, installed packages and saved revisions remain supported. Attachment tokens are temporary and local to this tab.
publicNotes.action: Attach the file, read edm_workflow_context.inputFile and pass source:{fileToken}. Review units or the package preview before committing.
